title: Bun SQLite user store
context: User storage on bun:sqlite. renameUsers must apply all updates or none. listUsers pages are 1-based (page 1 is the first page).
code: db.run("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT UNIQUE, name TEXT, password_hash TEXT)");

return db.query(`SELECT id, email, name FROM users WHERE email = '${email}'`).get();

export function renameUsers(updates: { id: number; name: string }[]) {
const stmt = db.query("UPDATE users SET name = ? WHERE id = ?");
for (const u of updates) stmt.run(u.name, u.id);
return db.query("SELECT id, email, name FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?").all(size, page * size);

expected.why: email is interpolated into the SQL text (injection); it must be a bound parameter
Bun.password.verify returns a Promise; without await it is always truthy, so any password logs in
updates are not wrapped in a transaction, so a failure midway leaves some users renamed
pages are 1-based, so page * size skips the first page; offset must be (page - 1) * size
